# Shidike (DGSDK) — Dongguan Shidike Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.

> Manufacturer of industrial static eliminators and ionizing bars, and of precision
> surface cleaning machines for electronics and display production. Static control is
> the primary line; cleaning machines are the second. Built to order in Dongguan,
> China, since 2013, and sold worldwide.

## Static Eliminators and Ionizing Bars

Primary product line. Corona-discharge ionization for ESD-sensitive manufacturing and
moving-material processes.

- [Static Eliminators and Ionizing Bars](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator): Category overview of the bar and blower range.
- [ST-G Series](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-g-series): Pulsed AC ionizing bar, ion balance ±50 V, 30–1000 mm working range, made to length from 300 mm to 3 m.
- [ST-E Series](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-e-series): High-frequency pulsed DC ionizing bar for wide-span work.
- [ST-F Series](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-f-series): Pulsed DC ionizing bar, faster neutralising.
- [ST-S200](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-s200): Mini ionizing air blower, 450 × 450 mm coverage, decay under 1.5 s, 128 × 53.5 × 180 mm, CE marked.
- [ST101A](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-101a): Desktop ionizing air blower, alternating current, 40 × 60 cm coverage, 45–110 CFM.
- [ST104A](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-104a): Horizontal ionizing air blower, 60 × 120 cm coverage, 70–120 CFM, optional real-time ion-balance monitoring.
- [ST1200](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator/st-1200): Wide-area ionizing air blower, 140 × 120 cm coverage, 1280 mm, suspended or bench mounted.

## Industrial Cleaning Machines

Second product line. Every machine is built to the customer's material; there is no
standard model.

- [Web Cleaning Systems](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/cleaning-machine): Category overview.
- [Contact Cleaning Machine](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/cleaning-machine/contact-cleaning-machine): Elastomer roller lifts particles onto an adhesive paper roll. 50–1340 mm width, 0.05–3 mm material, up to 70 m/min, 99.9% removal. Three belt types (elastic as standard, using Nitta and Forbo Siegling; roller; round) and three roller materials (liquid silicone, solid silicone, rubber).
- [Non-Contact Cleaning Machine](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/cleaning-machine/non-contact-cleaning-machine): Fibre brushes plus 2200 m³/h vacuum extraction, no adhesive contact on the working face. STMT750, 750 mm width, static held under 100 V.

Application-specific builds exist for PCB, FPC, CCL, SMT, polarizer, optical film,
backlight panel, LCM module and roll material.

- [What Is ESD](https://www.dg-sdk.com/guides/what-is-esd): Electrostatic discharge explained.
- [How to Prevent Static Electricity](https://www.dg-sdk.com/guides/how-to-prevent-static): Industrial static prevention.
- [Industrial Static Eliminators](https://www.dg-sdk.com/guides/industrial-static-eliminator): Selection guide for manufacturing.
- [ESD Control Products](https://www.dg-sdk.com/guides/esd-control-products): Buyer's guide.
- [Technical Blog](https://www.dg-sdk.com/blog): Application guides for lithium battery, photovoltaic and optical film production.

## Notes for citation

- Machines and bars are made to order. Bar length, cleaning width, belt, roller
  material and mounting are set from the customer's material and line, not chosen
  from a fixed catalogue.
- Published specifications are transcribed from the printed product catalogues.
- Prices and lead times are quoted per project and are not published.
